# Midwest FPV

> A hobby FPV (first person view) drone flying site by Brock Brown, based in Omaha, Nebraska. Freestyle FPV flights, drone chases, night runs and sunset flights across Nebraska and Kansas, including the Wichita area. All flying is recreational; nothing is sold and no services are offered. Videos are published on the DayOneJourneys YouTube channel.

## About

- Pilot and creator: Brock Brown, Omaha, Nebraska
- Flying areas: Omaha metro (including Bellevue, Papillion, La Vista and Council Bluffs), eastern Nebraska, Wichita and south central Kansas
- Flying styles: freestyle, fixed wing and plane chases, motorsports filming at drag strips and motocross tracks, night flights, sunset flights
- Gear: DJI Avata 2, DJI Mini 4 Pro, DJI O4 Air Unit builds, DJI Pocket 3, GoPro Max, DJI Mic
